cases.sentence: Иосии было восемь лет, когда он стал ___.
cases.translation: Josiah was eight years old when he became king.
cases.explain: The verb 'стал' (became) governs the instrumental case for predicate nominatives.

cases.sentence: На восемнадцатом году своего правления царь Иосия послал писаря Шафана в ___.
cases.translation: In the eighteenth year of his reign, King Josiah sent the scribe Shaphan to the house.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' with motion toward governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Пусть деньги отдадут людям, которые были назначены наблюдать за работами при ___.
cases.translation: Let the money be given to people appointed to oversee the work on the house.
cases.explain: The preposition 'при' (at, during) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Рабочие ремонтируют ___ Господа, плотникам, строителям и каменщикам.
cases.translation: Workers repair the house of the Lord, carpenters, builders and stonemasons.
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'ремонтировать' (to repair) governs the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Первосвященник Хелкия сказал писарю Шафану, 'Я нашел в ___ Господа книгу закона'.
cases.translation: The high priest Hilkiah said to the scribe Shaphan, 'I found in the house of the Lord a book of the law'.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) with location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Услышав слова из ___, царь разорвал на себе одежду.
cases.translation: When the king heard the words of the book, he tore his clothes.
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from, out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Велик ___ гнев, который обрушился на нас.
cases.translation: Great is the wrath of the Lord that has fallen upon us.
cases.explain: The possessive genitive 'of the Lord' modifies 'гнев' (wrath).

cases.sentence: Священник, Ахикам, Ахбор, Шафан и Асайя пошли к пророчице, жене ___.
cases.translation: The priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan and Asaiah went to the prophetess, the wife of Shallum.
cases.explain: The possessive genitive shows whose wife she was.

reading.ru: Иосии было восемь лет, когда он стал царем, и правил он в Иерусалиме тридцать один год.
reading.question: How old was Josiah when he became king, and how long did he reign in Jerusalem?
options: Eight years old, reigned thirty-one years
Twelve years old, reigned fifty-five years
Twenty-two years old, reigned two years
Five years old, reigned forty years
reading.correct: Eight years old, reigned thirty-one years
reading.explain: The text states 'Иосии было восемь лет' (Josiah was eight years old) and 'правил он в Иерусалиме тридцать один год' (he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years).

reading.ru: На восемнадцатом году своего правления царь Иосия послал писаря Шафана в дом Господа.
reading.question: Why did King Josiah send Shaphan the scribe to the house of the Lord?
options: To instruct the high priest to count the money brought to the Lord's house and oversee repairs
To collect taxes from the people
reading.correct: To instruct the high priest to count the money brought to the Lord's house and oversee repairs
reading.explain: The context indicates Josiah sent Shaphan to manage funds and organize work on the temple.

reading.ru: Первосвященник Хелкия сказал писарю Шафану, 'Я нашел в доме Господа книгу закона'.
reading.question: What important discovery did the high priest Hilkiah make?
options: He found the book of the law in the house of the Lord
He found a treasure of gold and silver
He found the resting place of David
reading.correct: He found the book of the law in the house of the Lord
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'Я нашел в доме Господа книгу закона' (I found in the house of the Lord the book of the law).

reading.ru: Услышав слова из книги закона, царь разорвал на себе одежду.
reading.question: How did King Josiah react when he heard the words of the book of the law?
options: He laughed and dismissed the priests
He immediately ordered the book to be burned
reading.explain: The text says 'царь разорвал на себе одежду' (the king tore his clothes), a sign of mourning or distress.

reading.ru: Велик Господень гнев, который обрушился на нас из-за того, что наши отцы не слушали слов этой книги.
reading.question: What reason is given for God's wrath falling upon the people?
options: Their fathers had not listened to the words of the book of the law
They had not built enough temples
They had not sacrificed enough animals
They had not conquered enough enemies
reading.correct: Their fathers had not listened to the words of the book of the law
reading.explain: The text states 'Велик Господень гнев' and explains it is because 'наши отцы не слушали слов этой книги' (our fathers had not listened to the words of this book).

reading.ru: Так как твое сердце смягчилось, и ты смирил себя перед Господом, то и я услышал тебя.
reading.question: What does the Lord say about Josiah's response to the book of the law?
options: Because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before the Lord, I have heard you
Because you were proud, I will punish you
Because you ignored the law, you will be destroyed
Because you built many temples, you will prosper
reading.correct: Because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before the Lord, I have heard you
reading.explain: The prophetess conveys God's words: 'Так как твое сердце смягчилось, и ты смирил себя перед Господом, то и я услышал тебя' (Because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before the Lord, I have heard you).
